comment: XR RELEASE MANIFEST — the single source of truth for release identity and every public claim. Constitution Article XXII.1 and Article XIX.1. Edit THIS file, then run `bun run release:stamp`. Never hand-edit a stamped surface. Phase 9 extended the manifest's authority to DISTRIBUTION: targets, channels, support tiers and the stability label live here and nowhere else.

identity.name: @rrrtx/xr
identity.description: XR — a local-first, provider-neutral AI agent runtime. BYOK, spend-capped, tamper-evident audit, plugin/MCP extensibility.
identity.author: Muhammad Ahmad (@ahmadrrrtx)

distribution.tagline: honestly labeled: validated, signed and reversible — and not finished. Known limitations are public.

channels.summary: Signed compiled binary straight from the release (default distribution).
channels.rollback: xr update is atomic; a failed canary auto-rolls back

channels.summary: Homebrew formula from the ahmadrrrtx/homebrew-tap tap.
channels.rollback: brew switch xr <previous-version> (brew keeps prior Cellar versions)

channels.summary: Scoop manifest from the ahmadrrrtx/scoop-bucket bucket.
channels.install: scoop bucket add ahmadrrrtx https://github.com/ahmadrrrtx/scoop-bucket; scoop install xr

channels.summary: WinGet community manifest (ahmadrrrtx.XR) — lags one registry review after each release.
Native .deb for Debian/Ubuntu from the canonical release assets.
channels.install: sudo dpkg -i xr_<version>_amd64.deb   # from the GitHub release

channels.summary: Native .rpm for Fedora/RHEL/openSUSE from the canonical release assets.
channels.install: sudo rpm -Uvh xr-<version>-1.<arch>.rpm   # from the GitHub release

channels.summary: npm package @rrrtx/xr (Bun required; OIDC trusted publishing).
Container image ghcr.io/ahmadrrrtx/xr with a signed digest.
Contributor path: git clone + bun install.
channels.install: git clone https://github.com/ahmadrrrtx/xr && cd xr && bun install

supportTiers.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml + cross-platform.yml (Linux x64 full tier + golden path)
no bun-windows-arm64 build target; installs fail honestly
supportTiers.notes: Tracked as a possible future target.

claims.text: Runs locally with local models; no mandatory cloud control plane.
claims.evidence: src/providers/presets.ts — local runtimes (ollama, lmstudio, llamacpp, jan, localai, vllm) are first-class provider presets; src/config/config.ts localModels.

claims.text: Bring your own API key — provider credentials stay in your environment.
claims.evidence: src/config/config.ts provider apiKeyEnv resolution; secrets redacted by src/baseline/status.ts:redactValue.

claims.text: Per-task budget ceilings in USD and tokens, enforced during the agent loop.
Hash-chained local audit log with a verification command.
claims.evidence: src/commands/audit.ts (verify); audit repo hash chain; test suite covers audit verification.
Directory count of skills/ at release commit — verified mechanically by scripts/claim-lint.ts (countSkills).

claims.text: Multiple model providers behind one interface; no vendor lock-in.
claims.evidence: src/providers/presets.ts and src/providers/registry.ts — provider-agnostic Provider interface.

claims.text: Plugin host and MCP client, available from CLI and interactive surfaces.
Written in TypeScript, running on Bun.
claims.evidence: package.json engines.bun; tsconfig.json; zero Rust sources in the repository.

claims.text: The compiled binary is the default distribution; npm and git checkout remain alternative channels.
claims.evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml (build-matrix job publishes 5 targets); bin/xr binary-first launcher; install.sh/install.ps1 fetch the release binary; test/release/release-build.test.ts.

claims.text: Release artifacts are signed cosign-keylessly by the release workflow and ship with checksums, a CycloneDX SBOM and SLSA provenance.
claims.evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml (cosign sign-blob per asset; SLSA generic generator); scripts/verify-release.ts; test/release/release-build.test.ts; docs/release/VERIFYING_RELEASES.md. Live Rekor proof materializes on the first real tag — see known-limitations.

claims.text: Linux, macOS and Windows run the full unit tier plus the golden path in CI.
claims.evidence: .github/workflows/cross-platform.yml (full bun test on 3 OS families + arm tiers) and the nightly golden-path workflow; docs/release/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md.

prohibitedClaims.reason: XR holds no SOC 2 audit. Article XIX forbids false certification claims.
XR has no HIPAA compliance program or BAA.
The repository ships 65 skills. Use the mechanically-verified skills-count claim.
XR contains no Rust. It is TypeScript on Bun.
XR enforces in-process policy, not kernel isolation. Isolation is a later phase.
Absolute security claims are never evidenceable.
